thread:
maria: FYI RC-2026.04 is queued for EU canary in ~90m. Automated SBOM check flagged a missing signature for the base image. Need decision: wait for provenance or carve out EU canary. @legal-review @ashok @sre-oncall please advise.

deploybot: SBOM artifact: https://ci.redwood.dev/artifacts/rc-2026.04/sbom. Scan summary: base image redwood/base:2026.04 -> signature lookup returned 404. Full scan log uploaded.

ashok: can you paste the cosign verify output? sometimes signatures are pushed as detached blobs.

deploybot: cosign verify output:
```
Error: no matching signatures found for image
```
Detached sig uploaded to s3://rb-inference-artifacts/rc-2026.04/cosign_detached.sig

release-manager: quick risk check  is there any P0/change that would affect EU customers?

maria: no P0s; mostly telemetry and perf tweaks. Compliance/enterprise customers expect signed provenance for EU rollouts.

legal-review: options: (A) successful cosign verify against registry, (B) attestations present in registry or SBOM with signer metadata, or (C) documented exception accepted by compliance. If we take (C) we must record the exception and include note in release notes.

sre-oncall: operationally we can carve out by region: `deploybot promote --stages=canary --regions=us-east-1,eu-west-nonprod` and block eu-prod. Also ensure the promote pipeline prevents accidental full-region promote.

maria: proposal: timebox 90 minutes for ashok to re-run signing pipeline and fetch evidence. If unresolved, carve out EU-prod and proceed with non-prod EU + US canary. Fallback: pin base-image to previous digest and re-run CI if legal requires.

ashok: on it. I'll re-run the signer job, check registry ACLs, and attempt to push a cosign detached signature if necessary. Please hold final promote until I update.

deploybot: acknowledged. I will not run final promote until a clear "go" message. Carveout command (if needed):
```
deploybot promote rc-2026.04 --regions=us-east-1,eu-west-nonprod --no-eu-prod
```

legal-review: note for release notes if carved out: "EU production canary delayed due to pending provenance verification. No customer-facing behavior changes expected. Full EU canary will resume after attestation confirmed."

ashok: debug note: signer job failed earlier due to registry quota error (429). Increased quota and re-triggering signer. Pushing detached signature now.

maria: thanks. keep this thread updated. If you need infra escalation ping @infra-team.

ashok: update +40m: re-run complete. cosign verify now returns:
```
Verified OK: registry.redwood.dev/redwood/base@sha256:abcdef1234567890
```
Detached signature verified. Uploaded attestation to registry.

deploybot: verification confirmed. Proceeding with normal canary promote. Starting canary in eu-prod + eu-nonprod + us-east-1.

legal-review: please add the attestation reference to the release notes under compliance: `attestation: registry.redwood.dev/attestations/rc-2026.04`. No exception needed.

maria: Great. Closing the timebox early. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
